# OpenFront reference attribution

This project includes Luau adaptations of OpenFrontIO source and encoded map data from https://github.com/openfrontio/OpenFrontIO, revision `93a136a1e2915ec7bb83e34980ba5836a91f63ee`.

The0.13 pass also adapts Quick Chat, original Solo configuration/teams/Doomsday, preferences/input/audio and WebGL render/debug/effect equations from that same pinned source under the AGPL notice. All130 selectable maps and260 Normal/Compact terrain/navigation assets retain original source hashes and lossless data; their catalog/navigation expectations are generated by the versioned map tools. Quick Chat/lobby/settings icons, original thumbnails/flags, China label pixels, modern level glyphs and the original conquest sword strip follow the resource attribution below, with source/pixel provenance retained in their preparation manifests/tools. The34 available original MP3s are copied unchanged into `assets/reference/audio`; `assets/reference/audio-assets-manifest.json` records original paths/hashes and the two unavailable source music paths. No replacement sounds or geographic resampling are supplied.

OpenFrontIO source is licensed under GNU AGPL version 3; the full text is included in `OpenFront-AGPL-3.0.txt`. Source adaptations identify their reference in comments and the parity audit. The original TypeScript was adapted for Roblox/Luau and its server/client transport.

Official map data comes from OpenFrontIO resources at the same revision. Resources are licensed under Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0, https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. The resource license notice is included in `OpenFront-resources-license.txt`. Imported terrain is losslessly run-length encoded; its original SHA256 and map dimensions are recorded in `assets/reference/map.json`. No geographic terrain edits or resampling are applied.

City, gold, build, back and deletion icons and the level-digit font atlas also come from the pinned OpenFrontIO resources under that resource license. SVG icons are rasterized for Roblox; the PNG font atlas is decoded without changing pixels. Original paths, source hashes and output pixel hashes are recorded in `assets/reference/city-assets-manifest.json`. `tools/prepare-city-assets.cjs` records the conversion, and `tools/import-city-assets.luau` imports the encoded pixels into Studio-owned `ReplicatedStorage.OpenFrontIcons`. Radial-menu masks are raster adaptations of the pinned `RadialMenu.ts` geometry; their source-code attribution follows the AGPL notice above.

Transport-ship pixels, boat icons, radial masks and attack-ring shader adaptations are recorded in `assets/reference/naval-assets-manifest.json` and prepared by `tools/prepare-naval-assets.cjs`. The sprite is preserved exactly; two color-band masks separate source tint channels. Attack rings adapt the source shader to native raster masks. The World navigation data in `assets/reference/navigation.json` preserves the official minimap and graph built by the pinned TypeScript; its hashes and generator are retained. Navigation, ship execution, naval AI and display code carry the same source attribution and license as the existing Luau adaptations.

Port icons, Trade Ship sprite/color masks, two-structure radial sectors and the original Overpass Bold MSDF atlas/metrics are recorded in `assets/reference/port-assets-manifest.json` and prepared by `tools/prepare-port-assets.cjs`. Font glyph pixels are compacted without resampling, retaining their original coordinates for source shader sampling. `BonusRenderer` adapts the original world-text shader and layout equations for native images. Port placement/AI, automatic trade execution and routing-cache adaptations carry the same pinned source attribution as the other Luau modules.

Warship/Sword icons, the original Warship sprite, original explosion/sinking atlas strips and tint masks are recorded in `assets/reference/warship-assets-manifest.json` and prepared by `tools/prepare-warship-assets.cjs`. Original resource attribution follows the CC BY-SA notice above. Selection/placement/radial masks and move-feedback equations adapt the pinned source shaders under the AGPL source notice. Warship/Shell executions, spatial grid, veterancy, Easy AI and selection/display adaptations carry the same source attribution.

Factory and Defense Post icons, original Train engine/empty/loaded sprites, rail dust and building explosion strips, polygon/range/radial masks and train tint bands are recorded in `assets/reference/industry-assets-manifest.json` and prepared by `tools/prepare-industry-assets.cjs`. Original resources retain the CC BY-SA attribution above; shader/SDF masks, train view motion, mixed ground-unit order, defense coverage, rail cache/paths/network and Factory/Defense/Train execution adaptations retain the pinned AGPL source attribution. Native sparse raster caching changes implementation and preserves the verified coverage equations/assets.

Missile Silo, SAM and nuclear icons, original missile/warhead/interceptor sprites, explosion/debris atlas strips and tint masks are recorded in `assets/reference/weapons-assets-manifest.json` and prepared by `tools/prepare-weapons-assets.cjs`. Original resources retain the CC BY-SA attribution above. Silo/SAM/nuclear executions, available Easy weapon AI, fallout, trajectories, telegraphs, range unions, effects and weapon menu/input adaptations carry the pinned AGPL source attribution.

Diplomacy icons, status masks and all 60 original emoji atlas cells are recorded in `assets/reference/diplomacy-assets-manifest.json` and prepared by `tools/prepare-diplomacy-assets.cjs`. Original resource attribution follows the CC BY-SA notice above. Alliance/request/embargo/gift/emoji/target executions, relations and available Easy nation/tribe diplomacy, source player actions, request cards, border tint and status geometry retain the pinned AGPL source attribution. Localization is adapted from the same reference resources.
